newsitem.title: POLAND: ANIMEX PAYS PLN 1.1 MLN FOR MEAT PLANT.
newsitem.headline: ANIMEX PAYS PLN 1.1 MLN FOR MEAT PLANT.

text.p: The Polish food trader Animex SA paid 1.08 million zlotys for a 55 percent stake in the Zaklady Miesne Mazury w Elku SA meat plant in the north-eastern town of Elk, the treasury ministry said in a statement on Friday.
It said 20 percent of Mazury's shares would be offered to its employees at preferential rates and 20 percent to producers long cooperating with the plant.
The treasury would keep five percent for reprivatisation claims.

Animex also agreed to raise Mazury's capital by three million zlotys from the current 19.56 million and invest $2 million in the company's fixed assets over the next three years. The capital is divided into 1,956,000 shares.
Animex will also maintain Mazury's 1,534 jobs for two years and raise wages by 15 percent.
